task: A baseline Zoom config file exists at /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf. Update FOUR keys: set HDVideo to true, set TouchUpMyAppearance to false, set mirrorMyVideo to false, and set AdjustForLowLight to true. Save the file in-place at the same path. Do not modify any other keys or sections.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use sed or Python to modify /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf: set [Video] HDVideo=true, TouchUpMyAppearance=false, mirrorMyVideo=false, AdjustForLowLight=true
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI agent can directly edit the config file using sed/awk or Python. Multiple key-value changes in one section are straightforward for CLI. Task mentions GUI Settings > Video but CLI is equally viable.
